title: Session-Switch Churn Across Games
dataSources: Game sessions (`game:session`), ranked matches (`ranked:match`), co-op invites (`coop:session`), speedrun attempts (`speedrun:attempt`), server events (`server:event`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), raid attempts (`raid:attempt`), and daily quest logs (`quest:completion`).
app: Gaming telemetry from platform session APIs, ranked-match exports, co-op schedulers, speedrun splits, server logs, raid trackers, and board-game play records streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=game:session
| sort 0 _time
| streamstats current=f last(title) as prev_title by player
| eval switched=if(title!=prev_title,1,0)
| stats sum(switched) as title_switches by player
| sort - title_switches
description: Measures how often a player jumps from one game to another instead of staying with the same title.
value: Frequent switching can be fun variety or a sign of restlessness, but either way it is more visible when counted directly.
implementation: Send game session starts with player and title labels from your launcher or platform API.
visualization: Bar chart of game-title switches by player.
grandmaExplanation: It spots how often someone keeps hopping between games instead of sticking with one.
